prompt:
Pixel art for a top-down 16-bit era console role-playing game (overworld town map). Camera: high oblique top-down view, the ground seen from above; buildings and objects show their roof or top surface plus a little of their front side facing the bottom of the screen; not isometric, not a side view. Crisp square pixels on one strict grid, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft gradients, no noise, no dithering texture. Limited palette of about 32 colours, 3 to 4 tones per material, dark coloured outlines (deep brown, deep blue-grey, never pure black) around objects, light from the top left. Neutral daylight colours (the evening light is added later in the game engine): fresh mid green grass, warm pale sand, teal-blue sea, cool grey-blue cobblestones, honey-brown weathered wood, white-washed walls, slate-blue roof. Clean, readable, cosy. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a painting.

Make a terrain tileset sheet. The whole image is a strict square grid of 8 columns by 8 rows of tiles filling the image edge to edge. Every tile is 16 by 16 art pixels and every art pixel is an 8 by 8 block of identical screen pixels (the image is 128 by 128 art pixels shown at 8x). No borders, gaps, frames, labels or grid lines between the tiles.
Row 1: eight grass fill tiles (short grass with a few darker tufts; two of them with tiny white and yellow flowers).
Row 2: eight sand fill tiles (fine pale beach sand with a few tiny pebbles; one with a small shell).
Row 3: eight sea-water fill tiles (calm teal-blue water with a few short light ripple strokes).
Row 4: eight cobblestone paving fill tiles (rounded grey-blue stones of similar size with dark mortar gaps).
Row 5: eight wooden jetty plank fill tiles (planks running left to right, dark gaps between the planks, a few nail heads).
Row 6: grass-to-sand edge tiles (straight edges, outer corners and inner corners).
Row 7: sand-to-water shoreline tiles with a thin white foam line (straight edges, outer and inner corners).
Row 8: cut-stone quay edge tiles: paving on top, a short vertical stone wall face below it dropping into the water.
Each fill tile in rows 1 to 5 must repeat seamlessly with itself on all four sides, and all fill tiles of one row must fit next to each other without visible seams.
The tiles will be used to build a top-down map of this place (do not draw the place itself, only the tile sheet): Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: square 1:1.

Make a character sprite sheet for this game: the badger courier as a small overworld walking sprite. Use the attached reference sheet only for the costume, the colours of the clothes and the body proportions; drawing style, resolution and palette follow the pixel-art description above. Chibi proportions: big head about 45 percent of the height, short legs, the whole character about 32 art pixels tall; every art pixel is an 8 by 8 block of identical screen pixels. Clear readable face: black-and-white striped muzzle, small dark eyes.
Row 1 (top): four walking frames facing right in side view, evenly spaced, same scale, feet on the same baseline: contact with the left foot forward, passing, contact with the right foot forward, passing. The scarf ends swing slightly behind.
Row 2 (bottom): three standing frames facing the viewer (front view), same scale, feet on the same baseline: neutral standing, the same with eyes closed (blink), the same with one paw raised in greeting.
The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.
All frames isolated on a fully transparent background, no ground, no cast shadows.

Image format: landscape 3:2.
